description: Finds case studies of i22, optionally filtered by service, customer and free text; each with title, customer, service, in use since and teaser where the page has one. Use it for references and examples. The content has no industry field: for an industry, filter by customer or put the industry in query. Retrieval needs no personal data; do not include any in queries.

customer.description: Part of the customer name, e.g. Telekom.

service.description: Slug (e.g. agentic-transformation), path or URL of a service from i22_ai_services_list.

name: i22_ai_cases_find
title: Find case studies of i22
